title: VoltPilot v2 Entity Config / Telemetry / Command Payloads
description: The E1a half of the v2 entity topic family (edge-desired-arbitration.md owns desired + arbitration): the per-entity retained CONFIG the Go core publishes on the local bus, the per-entity local TELEMETRY Layer 1 publishes, the core-owned retained COMMAND, and the cloud->edge entity-registry PUSH that transports the config set to the device. A brand-new contract, so schema_version starts at 1.0 (v2 README coexistence philosophy #4). The entity descriptor is the wire form of the cloud entity registry (measurement_point rows carrying entity_type/capabilities/guard config); capabilities follow the D-14 command vocabulary and guard limits + failsafe live HERE, in registry config, per decision D-9 - a failsafe carried only in a plan would die with the plan.

x-topics.registry-push: ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/v2/entities  (Cloud -> Edge, QoS1, RETAINED - one message carrying the device's full entity set; the proven inverter-config/sources-config pattern. An empty entities array removes every entity; an empty payload clears the retained slot outright (device unclaimed - the provisioning clearRetained precedent).)
x-topics.config: edge/entities/{entity_id}/config  (core -> Layer 1 / flows, RETAINED per entity - $defs/config. Publishing an empty payload clears the retained config = entity removed.)
x-topics.command: edge/entities/{entity_id}/command  (core -> Layer 1, RETAINED per entity - $defs/command. Published ONLY by the core after arbitration + guards; the successor of the retained edge/setpoint. An empty payload clears the retained command = nothing commanded.)

x-semantics.identity: The entity_id in every payload MUST equal the {entity_id} topic segment; consumers ignore mismatches (the v1 topic==payload identity rule).
x-semantics.failsafe: guards.failsafe.behavior is what the entity falls back to when nothing commands it (no active desired, stale plan - decision D-9): 'self-consumption' (storage: the v1 guards.SelfConsumption fallback), 'off' (consumers: safe state), 'release' (return the device to its native behavior, clear limits), 'measure-only' (entity is never actuated at all - grid meters, uncontrolled producers).
x-semantics.charge_from_grid_allowed: Storage guard posture per decision D-8: false OR ABSENT = the entity must never charge from the grid (commanded charge clamped to measured available PV; unknown PV blocks charge entirely). Only an explicit true releases the clamp.
x-semantics.signs: Shared with mqtt-telemetry-2.0 and the command vocabulary: storage setpoint_kw/battery_power_kw + = charge, - = discharge; grid power_kw + = import, - = export; generation is only ever capped (limit_kw/limit_pct reduce-only), never commanded to produce; consumer setpoint_kw + = consume (never negative - V2G out of scope).

entity_id.description: Entity id, MQTT-topic-safe (the provisioning ref pattern). The cloud entity registry row UUID is the recommended form.

entity_type.description: Domain type on top of the capability model (plan decision D10). OPEN vocabulary since E1b: the data-driven platform type CATALOG (services/api entitytypes/catalog.json) is the truth for known types - adding a type is catalog data + an optional driver, never a schema release. Examples include battery-hybrid, producer, grid-meter, wallbox, heating-rod and generic-load; the current catalog is authoritative. Consumers key BEHAVIOR on the declared capabilities and guards, never on the type string alone: no actuate list (or a measure-only failsafe) = measure-only; storage-shaped guard limits = the storage guard chain incl. D-8; max_generation_kw = producer reduce-only caps; otherwise the consumer clamp ([0, max_consumption_kw], + = consume).

channels.description: Flat numeric readings keyed by channel name (snake_case). Values are always numbers; a boolean state is 0/1.

capabilities.description: What the entity can report (measure) and what it may be commanded (actuate). The actuate command names are the D-14 vocabulary shared with edge-desired and mqtt-schedule-2.0. A measure-only entity (grid meter) simply has no actuate list.

min.description: Lower bound for numeric commands (e.g. setpoint_kw: -max_discharge).

guard_limits.description: Per-entity guard chain inputs (decision D-9: limits live in registry config, not in plans; the generalization of the v1 env-derived guards.Limits). All optional - an absent limit skips that clamp, EXCEPT charge_from_grid_allowed where absent = NOT allowed (D-8).

charge_from_grid_allowed.description: D-8: absent = NOT allowed; only explicit true releases the solar-only-charge clamp.

max_generation_kw.description: Producer nameplate cap: a limit_kw command is additionally clamped to [0, max_generation_kw]; limits only ever reduce.

max_consumption_kw.description: Consumer rated cap (E1b, additive): setpoint_kw and limit_kw on a consumer entity are additionally clamped to [0, max_consumption_kw]. Consumers are only ever commanded to CONSUME (+ = consume, per the D-14 sign convention); a negative consumer setpoint is clamped to 0 - feeding in from a consumer (V2G) is out of scope.

min_on_seconds.description: Consumer cycle guard (Verbrauchssteuerung Inkrement 3, additive): once commanded ON the entity is held ON for at least this long before a commanded switch-off takes effect - a TEMPORAL device-protection invariant enforced by the edge's stateful cycle guard (restrict-only: it delays/holds, never raises beyond a previously granted level). Absent = axis inactive (no invented protection).

min_off_seconds.description: Consumer cycle guard (additive): after a commanded switch-off the entity stays OFF for at least this long; a wish to switch ON earlier is held with an honest reason ('wartet - Mindestpause'). Absent = axis inactive.

max_starts_per_day.description: Consumer cycle guard (additive): at most this many commanded starts per site-local day; further starts are held until the day rolls over. Absent = axis inactive.

ramp_kw_per_min.description: Consumer cycle guard (additive): the commanded setpoint may change by at most this many kW per minute while ON (both directions - a hold toward the wish, never a raise beyond it). Absent = axis inactive.

flex_requirement.description: One ACTIVE required_by_deadline duty of a consumer entity (Verbrauchssteuerung Inkrement 6, OPTIONAL + ADDITIVE - an old edge ignores the block): the data the edge-local deadline fallback needs to start the task itself, at the latest at deadline minus remaining need, when NO fresh v2 plan lies (§13.5/D5). Composed CLOUD-side from the ACTIVE consumer_policy (kind=flexible_task, enforcement=required_by_deadline) + consumer_profile: power_kw and command are RESOLVED in the cloud (one truth - target on_off => rated power / command on_off; percent/kw => the resolved kW / command setpoint_kw), so the edge never re-derives policy semantics. Price-conditioned, opportunistic and reactive requirements are NEVER pushed here - the fallback exists only for deadline duties.

id.description: The stable requirement id (audit + fulfilment attribution).

timezone.description: IANA zone of the site (E7); absent = Europe/Berlin (the v1 pinning). The recurrence window is wall-clock in this zone, DST-correct.

to.description: The instance DEADLINE (local wall clock; 24:00 = end of day). to < from = an overnight window belonging to the day of `from`.

contiguous.description: true = one run block (E5). The fallback always runs contiguously from its start; the flag travels for honesty/display.

power_kw.description: The resolved run power: converts a remaining energy_kwh into remaining runtime and is the setpoint_kw value the fallback wishes.

command.description: The D-14 command the fallback emits (on_off true, or setpoint_kw = power_kw).

descriptor.description: One entity as the registry knows it. driver is an OPTIONAL opaque connection block for Layer-1 self-wiring (brand/model/family/communication/connection in the v1 sources busEntry shape); E1a carries it through verbatim, the v2 driver layer consumes it in a later increment.

edge_source_id.description: The edge-local source id this entity was adopted from (:8484 sources selection; the cloud pin measurement_point.edge_source_id). OPTIONAL + ADDITIVE (2026-07-29, vp-vier-erzeuger-p9 PR 4a): lets the device map its OWN source readings onto the entity for its LOCAL display - deterministic instead of order-guessing. An old edge ignores it.

charge_point_id.description: Die OCPP-ChargePointId, die diese Entitaet IST - der Cloud-Bindung device_charge_point.entity_id entnommen (Cockpit Phase 1 / E1). OPTIONAL + ADDITIV: es ist der Zwilling von edge_source_id einen Transport weiter - eine Ladesaeule ist keine Quelle in sources.json (sie waehlt UNS an), ihre Messwerte liessen sich also ueber keinen anderen Schluessel auf die Entitaet abbilden. Abwesend = keine Ladesaeule / eine aeltere Cloud, und dann veroeffentlicht die Box gar keine Ladepunkt-Telemetrie je Entitaet. Eine aeltere Edge ignoriert es.

owner_claimed.description: TRUE = an ACTIVE customer rule claims this component, so the plan executors inject NO market desire for it and the rule wins because no competitor exists (Steuerung Stufe 3, vp-steuerung-konzept-b3 §3.7 A3). OPTIONAL + ADDITIVE: ABSENT means false, which is what an older cloud sends and what every unclaimed component sends - the arbiter, the priority classes and D-4/D-5/D-6 are unchanged. An older edge ignores it and behaves exactly as before.

role_assignment.description: Die im Portal GESPEICHERTE Rollen-Zuordnung dieser Komponente (AE1 entity_role_assignment, Befund L4). Je Eintrag EIN Messkanal: welcher Rolle er zugeordnet ist und ob er die massgebliche (primaere) Messung dieser Rolle ist - dieselbe Grammatik wie das Portal, weil die Zuordnung dort per KANAL getroffen wird und nicht je Entitaet. OPTIONAL + ADDITIV: fehlt der Block oder ein Kanal darin, gilt auf der Box unveraendert topology.DefaultRole, und eine Anlage ohne eine einzige gespeicherte Zuordnung sendet exakt die Bytes von vorher. WICHTIG: eine Rolle, die der Box-Build nicht kennt, faellt STILL auf den Default zurueck - der ganze Push wird deswegen nie abgelehnt (eine Rolle ist Anzeige, kein Steuerweg). Sie beschreibt AUSSCHLIESSLICH Anzeige/Topologie und wird von componentapply.Derive nie gelesen: inverter.json/sources.json leiten ihre Rolle weiterhin aus dem Entitaetstyp ab.

channel.description: Der Messkanal aus capabilities.measure[], dem die Rolle zugeordnet ist.

role.description: Die zugeordnete Rolle (das Vokabular von topology.DefaultRole). Das Enum ist die HEUTIGE Menge; eine spaetere Rolle, die eine aeltere Box nicht kennt, faellt dort auf den Default zurueck statt den Push zu zerreissen.

primary.description: TRUE = die massgebliche Messung dieser Rolle. ABSENT = false; die Vorgabe-Regel (die ERSTE Kapazitaet einer Rolle ist massgeblich) gilt dann nur noch fuer Rollen, fuer die NIEMAND ausdruecklich massgeblich gesetzt wurde - genau die Regel der Cloud (TopologyService.topology).

driver.description: Der OPAQUE Layer-1-Anbindungsblock (brand/model/family/communication/connection in der v1-sources-busEntry-Form). Seit Stufe 1 ist er fuer eine PORTAL-verwaltete Anlage der LESEPFAD selbst: die Box leitet daraus ihre lokale Geraete-Konfiguration ab. Fuer eine box-verwaltete Anlage bleibt er - wie seit E1a - reine Durchreichung fuer die Schreib-Executoren (go-e/Shelly).

flex_requirements.description: OPTIONAL + ADDITIVE (Inkrement 6): the consumer's active deadline duties for the edge-local fallback. Absent/empty = no fallback (byte-identical pre-Inkrement-6 behavior).

config.title: edge/entities/{entity_id}/config payload
config.description: The retained per-entity config: the registry descriptor plus schema_version and the registry revision it came from.

edge_source_id.description: The adoption pin, mirrored from the registry descriptor (D-17) - the config IS the descriptor plus the applied revision.

flex_requirements.description: Mirrored from the registry descriptor (Inkrement 6) - the config IS the descriptor plus the applied revision.

revision.description: The registry push revision this config was applied from (echoed in the status heartbeat).

ts.description: Observation time (RFC 3339, UTC); absent = receive time.

command.title: edge/entities/{entity_id}/command payload
command.description: The guard-clamped command state the driver layer executes - core-owned, retained, re-derived continuously (the edge/setpoint successor). commands carries the granted values keyed by the D-14 vocabulary; an absent limit_kw/limit_pct means NO limit and MUST clear any previously applied limit (the 1.0 pv_limit_kw clearing rule).

control_enabled.description: The v1 two-gate posture carried per entity: false = the driver layer must not write (readbacks still run so the UI shows actual state).

source.description: Who the granted command came from - documented values: 'plan' (market desire from the plan executor), 'desired' (arbitration winner), 'failsafe' (registry failsafe active). Open set.

registry_push.title: ems/{t}/{s}/{d}/v2/entities payload (entity-registry push)
registry_push.description:
The cloud entity registry pushed to the device, retained: the device's FULL entity set in one message (subscribe = converge, reconnect = re-converge; the retained-config pattern proven three times over, D-11 rationale). The edge diffs against its persisted set: new/changed entities are (re)published as per-entity retained configs, removed entities get their retained config + command cleared.

STUFE 1: der Push traegt zusaetzlich component_authority. Ist sie 'portal', LEITET die Box ihre Wechselrichter-Auswahl und ihre sources.json aus den driver-Bloecken dieses Pushes ab (der eine Applier) - die lokale Bus-Mechanik (edge/inverter/config, edge/sources/config, Selbstverdrahtung, Telemetrie) bleibt dabei BYTE-IDENTISCH, nur der SCHREIBER der lokalen Dateien wechselt. Sie wendet NIE teilweise an: laesst sich auch nur EIN driver-Block nicht in eine gueltige Auswahl uebersetzen, bleibt der bisherige Zustand vollstaendig stehen und die Box meldet den Grund. Ein Push OHNE jeden driver-Block ist kein Soll und leert nichts.

revision.description: Opaque registry revision (the api uses the push's published_at instant). The edge echoes the applied revision in its status heartbeat 'entities' block, so the cloud can verify convergence.

component_authority.description: OPTIONAL + ADDITIV (Einheitsmodell Stufe 1). WER die Geraete-Konfiguration dieser ANLAGE besitzt - genau ein Zustand je Anlage, nie je Geraet. 'portal' = das Portal ist das Soll und die Box LEITET ihre lokalen Dateien (Wechselrichter-Auswahl, sources.json) aus diesem Push ab; 'box' = der Bestandsfall, die Box bleibt Autoritaet und der Push aendert an ihrer Geraete-Konfiguration NICHTS. ABWESEND heisst 'box' - ein aelterer Cloud-Stand darf niemals versehentlich als Uebernahme gelesen werden, und eine Box ohne Applier ignoriert das Feld ohnehin (sie bleibt damit box-verwaltet, so wie die Flotte es ueber das Edge-Stand-Register erwartet).

automation_paused_until.description: OPTIONAL + ADDITIV (Steuerung Stufe 4, B5). „Automatik pausieren“: bis zu diesem ABSOLUTEN Zeitpunkt ruhen Fahrplan und Regeln (jede Wunsch-Klasse bis einschließlich market), jede Komponente fällt auf ihren Registry-Failsafe; Messen, Guard-Kette, § 14a, Abregelung, Einspeise-Wache und contract/grid/safety bleiben. Absolut, nie eine Dauer: der Push ist retained, eine Box, die beim Ablauf offline war, hebt die Pause nach ihrer EIGENEN Uhr auf. ABWESEND = keine Pause. Neben automation_paused_until_revoked ist es das rollierende Ende NUR für eine ältere Box (Push-Zeit + 4 h, alle 3 h erneuert).

automation_paused_until_revoked.description: OPTIONAL + ADDITIV (UEMS AP-01 IP-4, Regel R0). „Ruhe bis zum Start“: die Anlage ruht BIS AUF WIDERRUF - dieselbe Pause wie automation_paused_until, aber ohne Ende; keine Uhr und kein abgelaufenes Ende hebt sie auf, nur ein Push OHNE dieses Feld. Nur mit true gesendet; ABWESEND = die Pause (falls vorhanden) endet an automation_paused_until, byte-gleich zu vorher. Der Publisher sendet immer auch automation_paused_until (für eine ältere Box, die dieses Feld überliest). Vektoren: override-vectors.json.

entities.description: May be empty: the device has no v2 entities (all local per-entity configs are cleared).
